title: Font fallback chains
description: ui/fonts/fallbacks.yaml of the game pack: for each family, the faces that draw the characters it lacks, tried in order; the faces that name a language come first, among their group, for that language (docs/architecture/ui.md#fonts).

families.description: The font-families the documents name that take this chain.

family.description: The family of a font under ui/fonts/, as the font file names it.

language.description: The language that tries this face first among its group (zh, ja, ko).

scale.description: The face's size as a fraction of the family's.
